reviews.title: Audit PR #952 unequal-height floor closure on destination main
reviews.head: 0b3f19b643387da8ea3f583945d1fef220e30b02
reviews.coverage: Read README/TASK/VERIFY/SOURCES and checker. Strict-floor algebra is inconsistent as assigned: prose defines r moving-to-fixed while the formula r+s_i v, slack s_i(s_i+2r·v), and floor max(0,-2r·v) require r=moving-minus-fixed. Exact 1D countercontrol: x_moving=0, y_fixed=1, v=+1; stated r=+1 gives F=0, so s=1/2 is admitted although actual distance becomes 1/2 (squared slack -3/4). The package verifier only checks captured replay bytes, not orientation algebra.
reviews.scientific_limitations: Publish a scoped erratum reversing orientation wording to moving-minus-fixed (or consistently negate formula/floor), preserve frozen source bytes, update coverage/checker description, and independently recheck amended exact scope before acceptance.
